'''Neek''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. They were part of a group that were stranded on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] in [[4 BBY]] following an [[Ambush of the Maya Pei Brigade|attack on the brigade]]. 

==Biography==
===Attacked===
By [[4 BBY]], Neek had joined the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] to fight against the [[Galactic Empire]]. In 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], the brigade was [[Ambush of the Maya Pei Brigade|attacked]] and Neek was apart of a group of at least sixteen members of the brigade that survived the attack and escaped aboard a [[starship]] that landed on [[Yavin 4]]. However [[Bardi's brother|one member]] of the group subsequently departed in the ship leaving Neek and the rest of the group stranded on the [[moon]]. The group later encountered and [[death|killed]] an individual named [[Porko]] that they found near a clearing with a damaged [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

===Stranded===
Two [[Standard day|days]] after being stranded on the moon, Porko's companion, a man named [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], landed near the HOY-39 in a [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|stolen]] [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]]. As Andor approached the HOY-39 calling out for Porko the brigade members revealed their presence and took Andor prisoner. As two members of the group [[Gerdis]] and [[Bardi]] took turns trying to interrogate Andor, Flek watched from the sidelines. The interrogation was interrupted when [[Rika]], a member of the group, found the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[pilot]] [[helmet]] in the TIE and proclaimed that Andor was an Imperial test pilot. Later that day, Neek and two other members, [[Nazy]] and [[Flek]] were assigned to guard Andor while Rika tried to learn to fly the TIE. A short conversation between the guards and Andor was interrupted and the three guards took cover when Rika pressed a button causing the TIE's [[laser cannon]]s to fire in to the [[jungle]] near the group.<ref name="One Year Later" /> 

===A group divided===
[[File:Neek-OneYearLater.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Neek while guarding Andor]]
That night, an argument between the group erupted when discussing who should be in charge ultimately coming to a head when [[Crab]] shot Rika with his [[blaster]] and [[Rowd]] responded by shooting Crab. The brigade members exchange fire between each other while splitting into two factions; with Neek siding with Bardi, [[Musk]], Rowd, [[Tick (individual)|Tick]], [[Nazy]] and [[Flu (individual)|Flu]] and regrouping at the TIE while the other group retreated to the crashed HOY-39.<ref name="One Year Later" /> The following morning the [[Rowd]] a member of the group cut open a fowl smelling [[Yavin 4 melon]]. Neek warned against eating it, stating that if it tasted anything like it smell it would not be good. However Bardi eventually mustered up the courage and takes a bite. Later in day the group began trying to use rope to rotate the TIE so that its weapons would point towards the other group. When other group found out about the move they opened fire at the TIE forcing the Neek's group to suspend their attempts. That night Gerdis decided to issue a challenge to Bardi to settle the dispute. The two groups cross towards each other before all dropping their weapons in unison. Neek held a torch as they watched the two leaders engage in a game of [[Five Hands]] with [[Roski rules]]. While the group watched the game, Andor took the opportunity to escape. While Andor was making his way past the group to the TIE, a [[Yavinian doodar]] came out of the [[jungle]] and scooped Bardi and Gerdis in it's mouth. The rest of the group, including Neek scrambled for their guns and began to shoot wildly into the jungle. When the group realized that Andor had made it to the TIE and was taking off the group began shooting at the TIE but were unable to stop it from leaving.<ref name="Sagrona Teema">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Neek had dark skin, [[color|brown]] [[eye]]s and black [[hair]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Equipment==
While stranded on Yavin 4 Neek carried a [[blaster pistol]] and wore a dark green [[jacket]], tan [[clothing|pants]], a brown [[harness]] and a brown [[scarf]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Behind the scenes==
Neek was portrayed by [[Dylan Brady]] in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's first and second episodes, "[[One Year Later]]" and "[[Sagrona Teema]]," which were both released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The character's name had been previously revealed on Brady's listing on the website of their talent agency.<ref name="DylanBrady">{{WebCite|url=https://theartistspartnership.co.uk/artist/dylan-brady|text=DYLAN BRADY|archivedate=20250309130525}}</ref>
